title: fix(app-shell): key the post-publish readiness re-check to the app it ran for
body:
Fixes #4522

Head is `a39f00bf2`, which merges current `main` (`57e668f13`) — clean, no conflicts; #5178 lands in this package but not in `console/AppContent.tsx`.

## The defect

`AppContent` re-checks metadata once when a requested app is absent, because the registry can lag a beat behind a publish — that refresh is what lets a just-built app resolve on its own instead of flashing "App not available". The state driving it recorded only THAT a re-check had run, never WHICH app it ran for, and was reset on exactly one condition: `requestedAppMissing` going false.

Two missing apps in a row never satisfy that condition. `requestedAppMissing` is true before the transition and true after it, so the state rode across the navigation as `done` and the second app got **no re-check at all** — an app reached second in one mount (launcher, then a typo'd URL, then the real freshly-published app) showed the not-available screen with no refresh behind it. Retry still worked, so the cost is one skipped refresh, not a wrong screen.

## The fix

The run is stored with the app it ran for and read back only for that app — the same keying the access probe 30 lines below already uses (#4252, landed in #4521), rather than a second pattern in one file. That sibling's comment claimed this state was "deliberately left alone"; that sentence is now corrected in place.

Two deliberate details, both commented at the call site:

- The run is settled **by name** rather than by that probe's `cancelled` flag. This effect re-runs on its own state change, so a cleanup-based cancel would fire on the way out of `checking` and strand the check there forever.
- The reset branch keeps its **`if` guard**. See below — the first version of this PR dropped it and that was a real regression.

## The regression this PR shipped once, and what it taught

The first push turned `Test (shard 2/4)` red in a file this PR does not touch: `apps/console/src/__tests__/AppContent.systemHubRoutes.test.tsx`, whose record route rendered a permanently empty content area. Measured rather than re-run:

| leg | result |
| --- | --- |
| that file on unmodified `origin/main`, 3 runs | 15/15 pass, 3 times |
| that file on this branch, 3 runs | 1 failed / 14 passed, 3 times |
| same branch tree, only `AppContent.tsx` reverted | 15/15 pass |

So: deterministic, and mine. **Not** the flake it resembled, and **not** #5194 — that hypothesis is disproved here: the redirect chain completes correctly (`/apps/setup/system/workgroups` then `/apps/setup/system/record/workgroups`) and the element is still absent after **9 seconds**, nine times `findBy`'s budget, so nothing was racing a module load.

The mechanism is an infinite render loop — 4250 un-acted `AppContent` updates in the first second. `refreshMetadata` is a dependency of the re-check effect and its identity comes from the host's metadata context: the shipped `MetadataProvider` memoizes it, but a host (or a test mock, which is what `apps/console` uses) that returns a fresh function each render makes the effect run after every render. The original code's `if` guard made that a no-op; keying the state, I replaced it with an unconditional functional `setState`, which re-renders, which re-runs the effect. What a loop starves is anything downstream that needs it to quiesce — here the **lazy** route inside `ConsoleLayout`, which never mounts. Restoring the guard fixes it: 15/15 green.

It is pinned in this package too, so it cannot come back through `app-shell` alone: a lazy child mounted through `extraRoutes` under a resolved app with an unstable `refresh` identity. Verified red against the looping version and green with the guard.

That pin asserts the **consequence**, not a render count, and deliberately so: this surface already churns under these mocks — measured on unmodified `main`, 20 and 66 renders per 20ms window (the auth mock hands back a fresh `getAuthConfig` each render and the features effect writes a fresh `{}`). That churn is pre-existing and out of scope here; this fix happens to lower it to 2 and 12. Any bound tight enough to catch the loop would fail on `main` too, so a lazy child either mounts or it does not.

## The keying test

`AppContent.missingRecheckKeying.test.tsx` navigates **between two missing apps inside one mount** (`useNavigate`, same route element, params change) and asserts a second `refreshMetadata`. A case that mounts with a single missing app and asserts one refresh passes against the unfixed code, so no case is written that way.

Red-before / green-after on the final test file, the red leg with only `AppContent.tsx` reverted to `origin/main`:

| case | on `origin/main` | with the fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| a freshly published app reached SECOND in one mount gets its re-check | fail | pass |
| the second of two consecutive missing apps is re-checked | fail | pass |
| a previous app's in-flight re-check never settles the current app's | fail | pass |
| an app that becomes available and goes missing again is re-checked afresh | pass | pass |
| Retry re-runs the check for the app on screen | pass | pass |
| an app that resolves is never re-checked | pass | pass |
| a missing app is re-checked ONCE (no refresh loop) | pass | pass |
| a lazy route under a resolved app still mounts (unstable `refresh`) | pass | pass |

The last row is the loop pin; against the looping version it fails.

## Gates

On `a39f00bf2` (head, post-merge):
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ apps/console/src/__tests__/AppContent.systemHubRoutes.test.tsx` — 55 files, 398 passed, exit 0
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/{views,hooks,utils,providers}/` (the regions #5178 landed in) — 327 files, 3367 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` — exit 0, after building the dependency closure
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run lint` — exit 0, 0 errors; new test file clean, `AppContent.tsx` keeps exactly its three pre-existing warnings (128, 134, 158), none in the edited region
- `check-control-bytes.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` — exit 0

On `45dd7f6dd` (same tree pre-merge):
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` — 436 files, 4213 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/` — 55 files, 656 passed, exit 0

Changeset: `.changeset/missing-recheck-keyed-by-app-4522.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, patch).

## Scope

`AppContent.systemHubRoutes.test.tsx` is **not modified** — it caught a real regression and was left exactly as it is. No timeout was raised and no retry added. Both neighbours the card names stay untouched: #4521's access-probe state is already fixed and pinned (only the stale sentence in its comment changed), and out of scope: #4486 remains open, nothing here depends on it. Nothing under `src/views/**` or `src/hooks/**` is edited.
